t2: Explore the Dhaka Bypass Expressway's strategic route, key locations, toll information, and traveler facilities
t33: The Dhaka Bypass Expressway creates a strategic corridor around eastern Dhaka, connecting four major national highways (N1, N2, N3, N4). This expressway enables travelers to bypass Dhaka's congestion, cutting journey time by up to 75%.
t43: The Dhaka Bypass Expressway is Bangladesh's first fully enclosed highway, serving as a major arterial route around Dhaka. It starts near Kodda (Gazipur) and terminates at Madanpur, where it meets the Dhaka-Chattogram Highway (N1).
t44: This strategic corridor connects four major national highways (N1, N2, N3, N4), creating an uninterrupted pathway for vehicles to traverse from the north/northwest of Dhaka to the southeast without entering the capital's congested streets.
t45: 12 bridges and 7 flyovers across the route
t49: A 18 km section of the expressway (from Bhogra, Gazipur to Kanchan) was opened on a trial basis in late March 2025 to alleviate traffic for Eid-ul-Fitr travelers.
t50: This section (K3+900 to K22+00) offered toll-free travel during the Eid period, benefiting over 2 million travelers.
t55: The Dhaka Bypass Expressway connects several strategic locations, providing efficient access to major highways and urban centers:
t57: Starting point in Gazipur District that links to National Highway N4 (Dhaka-Mymensingh/Tangail Highways) and N3 (Dhaka-Mymensingh).
t60: Highway link to N4 and N3
t66: First section opened for Eid 2025, where K3+900 marks the beginning of the partial toll collection point.
t75: Interchange providing access to the upcoming Purbachal New Town, enhancing urban expansion.
t84: Mid-route interchange that intersects with the Dhaka-Sylhet Highway (N2), connecting the expressway to eastern regions.
t93: Endpoint in Narayanganj District that connects to National Highway N1 (toward Chattogram port) and links to N2 via nearby connections.
t102: The Dhaka Bypass Expressway operates as a toll road to maintain high service standards and ensure sustainable operations.
t118: Large Truck with at least 3 axles (trailer) 15-25 tons
t130: Medium Truck with at least 2 axles (5>7 tons)
t160: Pick Up, Jeep, Wrecker, Converted Jeep, Crane
t173: The Dhaka Bypass Expressway offers modern amenities to ensure a safe and comfortable journey for all travelers:
t175: Two service areas (one in each direction) with amenities for travelers to rest and refresh.
t180: Five toll plazas strategically placed to efficiently collect tolls from expressway users.
t185: Round-the-clock emergency response services to assist with accidents or breakdowns.
